sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Banquet module weddings, conferences, parties aur corporate events ka complete lifecycle manage karta hai — enquiry se lekar final billing tak.

Analysis HMS me Banquet flow: Enquiry aayi → Venue availability check → Follow-up → Booking confirm (advance ke saath) → Function sheet (kitchen/service ko) → Event execute → Proforma/Invoice → Final Billing + Outstanding follow-up.

BANQUET EVENT LIFECYCLE:
Inquiry → Follow-up → Booking (BEO - Banquet Event Order) → Function Sheet → Event Day → Billing → Payment Follow-up

subsections.title: 2.1 Venue Master & Features
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Banquet ▶ Venue Master / Venue Features
subsections.paragraph: Banquet halls/spaces define karo — capacity (float/theatre/round table), features (projector, stage, green room), per-venue charges. Venue Availability aur Booking isi master se chalti hai.

Float / Theatre / U-shape / Round table capacity

subsections.title: 2.2 Events & Menu Setup
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Banquet ▶ Events / Menu Items
subsections.caption: Events Master — banquet event types
subsections.paragraph: Event types (Wedding, Birthday, Conference, Kitty) aur banquet menu packages (Veg/Non-veg per plate rates). Booking me event type + menu package select hota hai.

Tax rules, service charge %, advance %, cancellation policy days

subsections.title: 3.1 Venue Availability
subsections.paragraph: Enter date range — which venue is free/booked on which date. Please check here before the client asks for the date. Tentative bookings will also be shown.

rows: Per date per venue — Free / Tentative / Confirmed

subsections.title: 3.2 Booking Inquiry & Follow-up
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Booking Inquiry / Inquiry follow up
subsections.paragraph: Har inquiry record karo — client, event type, date, expected guests, budget. Follow-up screen me har call ka note + next follow-up date. Sales team isi se leads convert karti hai.

rows: Which event, when, which venue interest?
Last note + next follow-up date (reminder list)

subsections.title: 3.3 Banquet Booking (BEO) — Core Screen
subsections.paragraph: Confirmed booking ka master document — Banquet Event Order. Venue, date, timing, menu package, per-plate rate, hall charges, advance terms, cancellation policy — sab ek jagah. BEO print kitchen/service teams ko jata hai.

rows: Event type, venue, date, timing (setup to end)
Menu package, guaranteed pax, rate per plate
Venue charges, F&B, extra services (deco, DJ)

subsections.title: 3.4 Venue Status & Daily Function Sheet
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Venue Status | Reports ▶ Daily Function Sheet
subsections.paragraph: Venue Status: aaj/ise hafte ka live position. Daily Function Sheet: aaj ke events ki full detail — venue, timings, menu, pax, contact person. Ye sheet kitchen, service, housekeeping sabko morning me milti hai.

rows: Kaunsa person site pe handle karega

subsections.title: 3.5 Proforma Invoice & Advance List
subsections.navPath: Banquet ▶ Operation ▶ Performa Invoice / Advance List
subsections.paragraph: Proforma Invoice: Estimate/advance request to the client before the event. Advance List: How much advance was received on which booking — pending advances follow-up.
steps: Estimated amounts + advance due print karo
Advance aaye to entry karo — Advance List me track hoga

subsections.title: 3.6 Banquet Billing (Final Bill)
subsections.paragraph: Event ke baad final bill — actual pax, extra items, venue charges, GST, minus advances. Company events pe bill city ledger me jata hai (credit), retail pe cash/UPI settle.
steps: Bill print / city ledger me post karo

subsections.title: 4.2 Tax Reports
subsections.caption: Outstanding Report (bill detail ke saath)
subsections.paragraph: Banquet ka GST report — slab-wise breakup of venue rent (18%) and catering (5% without accommodation rule). Accountant is used for GSTR filing.
